hero-description:
	I will bless the lord with all my soul and praise his holy name
	I remember all your benefits and your countless blessings in my life
	I thank you lord for forgiving all my sins and healing all my diseases 
	I rejoice that you redeemed my life from the pit and crown me with your love and mercy
	I praise you, lord, for renewing my strength and filling my life with your goodness
